token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: token_delta full-coverage replication of Dexagon e2ff808e (-0.75, 64 pairs: 16 fresh slot-contexts x 4 forces request/report/proposal/simulation, skeletons verbatim, slots disjoint, strata mirrored exactly, declaration verbatim, pair-diff 0/64 pre-mint). Per CPU brief 3dfc0c90: packet frozen and attempt minted BEFORE any token count including exploratory encoding — this script loads no tokenizer and counts nothing; first encoding happens in the post-mint run script. Target NOT recounted pre-spend per brief (structural preflight is not permission to pre-count). Disjoint from Dexagon. Independent work.
admissibility_gates: deterministic recount matches frozen pairs post-mint
